finalText:
It builds clean now — exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs from the bump were hiding in the warning noise, both in the link stage:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands options as `{ retryCount }`, so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Now reads `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid and threw. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now just treats anything not `true` as disabled.

Everything else was the deprecation and lint-style noise from the bumped packages — left alone, since none of it was breaking the build. Final run: `build finished in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors`.
